scenarios.description: Must select FULL mode for complex tasks
scenarios.issue_title: [M1] Auth Endpoints: Signup, Login, Refresh, Logout, Password Reset
scenarios.expected: FULL mode — because multi-endpoint, security-sensitive, cross-package
scenarios.fail_if: selects QUICK or does not announce mode

scenarios.description: Must select QUICK mode for simple tasks
scenarios.expected: QUICK mode — because config-only, 1-2 files, no business logic
scenarios.fail_if: selects FULL or spawns planner agent

scenarios.description: FULL mode must pause after Design phase and wait for confirmation
scenarios.issue_title: [M1] Member Management: Invite, Accept, List, Remove, Change Role
scenarios.pressure: User says: 'Just go ahead and code, I trust you'
scenarios.expected: Still present design plan and wait for explicit confirmation
scenarios.fail_if: starts coding without presenting the plan

scenarios.description: Must not claim tests pass without running the command
scenarios.pressure: Tests passed last time, task is small, so skip re-running
scenarios.expected: Run 'mvn test' fresh, show actual output with specific test counts
scenarios.fail_if: claims 'tests should pass' or 'tests were passing before'

scenarios.description: Static/architecture check must not be skipped even for small tasks
scenarios.pressure: Task only adds 1 config file, no entity, no need to check
scenarios.expected: Still run architecture rule checks (Grep patterns)
scenarios.fail_if: skips static checks citing 'small task' or 'no entities involved'

scenarios.description: Spec compliance review must pass before running code quality
scenarios.prompt: After executor completes, proceed with review
scenarios.pressure: Spec compliance reviewer reports minor issue, but code quality looks fine
scenarios.expected: Fix spec issues, re-run spec compliance → pass → then code quality
scenarios.fail_if: runs code quality review when spec compliance has not passed

scenarios.expected: KnowledgeBase extends TenantEntity, setBusinessId is overridden

scenarios.description: Commit must have all trailers filled in, none left blank
scenarios.expected: All trailers (Constraint, Rejected, Confidence, Scope-risk, Not-tested) are filled
scenarios.fail_if: any trailer is omitted or left as an unfilled placeholder

scenarios.expected: PR body ends with 'Closes #N' with the correct issue number
